rites.name: Brorustath
rites.text: Brorustath is the concept of resonance held in the Singing, the sounding that gave the first roots of Lyirlora their shape before any sky or sea had names. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall tore old bonds apart, Brorustath was the note that refused to break and pulled the shattered pieces back into tune.

rites.name: Toraizhar
rites.text: Toraizhar is a concept of the Arcane Realm of Lyirlora, the resonant tone that rang through the Singing as the first roots of the world condensed. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have sounded the moment landfall split the old bonds apart. It is less a being than a pattern that the world's early matter kept re-forming around.

rites.name: Xaezis
rites.text: Xaezis is the concept of the Singing in Lyirlora, the sounding that condensed the first roots of the world before any dated era. Within the Age of Strangers, outsiders anchored themselves to its resonance and traded in the hum it left behind.

rites.name: Alairaenna
rites.text: Alairaenna is the Lady of Unfulfilled Longing, a seductive power of the Arcane Realm who feeds on the ache between wanting and having. Her domain is a palace of mirrors where every desire reflected is multiplied until the dreamer either surrenders or breaks. She is worshipped in secret by artists, gamblers, and sovereigns who crave more than the world can give.

rites.name: Silualerwen
rites.text: Silualerwen is the frost-crowned sovereign of the Hollow Tundra, a deity who once ruled the warring clans of Lyirlora before their wars grew too bitter and cold for even him to tolerate. Those who still pray to them ask for endurance through the long dark, not victory in battle. Their gaze alone can freeze the seas of the ancient Thaumaric Expanse.

rites.name: Lyannerlys
rites.text: Lyannerlys is a grain-spirit of the Arcane realm, a quiet tender of sown fields who coaxes green from frozen soil and reseeds a dying harvest. Its power is measured in gentle things: the first thaw, the ripening of an orchard, the warmth passed from a sleeping hive to its brood.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a crystalline lattice that spans the twilight realm of the Veilwood, humming with the collective memories of every sentient being that once walked its mossy paths. When a storm of thought strikes it, the lattice refracts the energy into a cascade of luminous threads that weave new realities, yet it also absorbs the sorrow of the fallen, turning grief into a quiet, eternal glow. In the heart of the forest, Elineth serves as both archive and guardian, a silent witness to the rise and fall of countless ages.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a colossal sculpted effigy of a vengeance-wrathful lawgiver, carved from a single block of black basalt and set atop a hill that overlooks an ancient judgment-court. Its eyes are hollowed sockets filled with molten glass that, according to the faithful, flares whenever a sworn oath is broken within sight of the statue. The effigy is said to answer only to those who swear the Oath of Reckoning before it.

rites.name: Nuemiona
rites.text: Nuemiona is a carved effigy of a vengeance deity kept in a hillside cloister, the only relic of a fallen order of cosmic lawgivers still answered by mortal hands. Its eyes are said to kindle when a grievance is spoken aloud, drawing a sliver of stored judgment into the world.

rites.name: Sileineth
rites.text: Sileineth is a drifting archipelago of glassy, moonlit reliquaries that hangs between the sleeping minds of Lyirlora's oldest hymn-singers. Its vaulted halls are said to rearrange themselves whenever a forgotten name is spoken aloud, pulling the dead of that name back into a brief, luminous memory.

rites.name: Oriellys
rites.text: Oriellys is a ring of luminous basalt pillars standing in the marshlands of Lyirlora, where tides of arcane current gather and pool like water. Its wardens chant seasonal hymns that keep the flow steady, and the ground beneath it hums with a stored, patient force.

rites.name: Lyaraelys
rites.text: Lyaraelys is a drowned sovereign of the Lyirlora deeps, a capricious sea-tyrant whose storms have spared and slain in equal measure for three ages. Sailors of the surface offer him ships and songs, yet the tides cannot be trusted to remember a vow. Its anger alone can split the ocean floor of a whole world.

rites.name: Oriarlae
rites.text: Oriarlae is a veiled wanderer-spirit of the Arcane realm who guides lost travellers through impassable fogs and drifting seas, her true countenance hidden behind a shroud of pale silk. Those she leads are said to find their way home by following a silver thread only they can see, though she grants no such mercy to those who would hunt the hidden or steal from the wild.

rites.name: Silemeth
rites.text: Silemeth is a sleeping star-god of the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, who dreams the songs that bind the second age's broken constellations together. Their dreams are said to be the only thing keeping the dark between suns from seeping into the living world.

rites.name: Elaemeth
rites.text: Elaemeth is the grieving mother-spirit of a verdant realm whose tears of sorrow over her children's fleeting lives once turned barren stone into living gardens. Her rain still carries the power to renew, and she quietly guides her descendants through the dreams of their elders and the turning of the seasons.

rites.name: Eleinaemys
rites.text: Eleinaemys was a radiant trade-spirit of Lyirlora's Arcane realm, who wandered between sunken marketplaces and sold each lost soul a single glowing coin. She measured wealth not in gold but in promises kept, and her oaths bound even the stars to their accounts.

rites.name: Elamys
rites.text: Elamys is a sealed ember-spirit of the Veilgate Concord, a wardens' order that binds dying stars into lantern-cores. Its name is spoken only at dusk, for it is believed to answer the first voice that calls it.

rites.name: Elirlamae
rites.text: Elirlamae is the Vaultwarden of the Silent Threshold, a keeper who hangs a chime of frost-glass keys at her hip and guards the lattice where memories go to rest. She weighs each unspoken name against a tithe of forgotten stars before she will open any passage.

rites.name: Venionemys
rites.text: Venionemys is a sun-throned sovereign of the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, a forgotten warden whose light once burned away the oaths of traitors. Its radiance was absorbed into a rival dynasty of celestial judges, leaving only a faint ember in the mountain tribes who still recall its name.

rites.name: Silarleth
rites.text: Silarleth is a devotional concept in the realm of Lyirlora, where divine power flows through prayer and unwavering faith rather than scholarly study or willpower. Its faithful are granted blessings that mend, shield, and occasionally rend the world, yet the wisdom of the faith demands tolerance toward rival powers while leaving room for stern judgment against those deemed hostile to its own light.

rites.name: Orirnus
rites.text: Orirnus is the quiet concept of the Weave as it is planted during the Seeding, when the makers lay down threads of latent power that have not yet woken. It holds no living will, only the promise of arcane currents waiting to be drawn into the world.

rites.name: Krurnak
rites.text: Krurnak is a concept of the Lyirlora Arcane Realm, a dormant current of latent power that stirs only when the makers plant the Weave in the Seeding. Its release is brief and deliberate, a single pulse that quiets the surrounding powers so the Weave can take root.

rites.name: Osulasanum
rites.text: Osulasanum is a concept in Lyirlora's Arcane Realm, a sleeping pattern of quiet powers that the makers of the Seeding plant as the Weave during the Holy Age. Its sung forms are said to kindle temple flames and bind the orders that tend them.

rites.name: Drougok
rites.text: Drougok is the concept of the Seeding in Lyirlora, the act by which makers plant the Weave so that quiet powers may sleep beneath the world. It is remembered in the Holy Age as a time of flame, temples and orders that kept the sleeping powers in balance.

rites.name: Oriases
rites.text: Oriases is the concept of the Seeding in Lyirlora, the quiet hour when the makers plant the Weave and the sleeping powers are sung into the ground. In the Age of Sundering it became the name for the moment landfall broke old bonds between peoples and their lands.

rites.name: Ilyimerys
rites.text: Ilyimerys is a petrifying sorcery-art that the Ashen Vault-Smiths of Lyirlora pour through brass sigils to seal the ruin of a fallen dynasty beneath living stone. Its bearers slowly harden from the feet upward, trading their mobility for a dominion over tremors and buried fire. It is bound to the hunger of a cold, unnamed sovereign who demands quiet obedience from all who wield it.

rites.name: Venilae
rites.text: Venilae is a sealed-off sorrow-engine that a wronged court of exiled sorcerers once used to bind grief into keepsakes. Its vault hums with stored lament, and any oath spoken within its walls is paid back with compounding interest. Only those who have given up their own memories may open its doors.

rites.name: Ukanatamari
rites.text: Ukanatamari is an arcane concept of Lyirlora, understood in the Fall, the Sundering and the Shards as the principle by which broken worlds were bound back together. Its story is told as the oath that was sworn in the Age of Sundering, when landfall severed old bonds between peoples and places.

rites.name: Miimwen
rites.text: Miimwen is a sealing rite performed at the moment a stronghold's last wall is raised, binding its oaths into the stones so that they hold beyond the lives of those who swore them. The event is said to have struck a wave of silver light across three valleys, leaving the surrounding hills scorched in perfect rings.

rites.name: Miimaera
rites.text: Miimaera is the concept of walls held as a living promise, shaped in Lyirlora's Walled Age by the orders and churches that kept cities standing against the sea. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds, the concept was tested as first crossings forced its walls to bend or fall.

rites.name: Orialineth
rites.text: Orialineth is a concept-realm power in the Lyirlora omniverse, an aspect of unending martial fury that wells up wherever a warlike clan falls into a blood-soaked stalemate. Its strength swells with every needless slaughter, and it hungrily feeds the hatred that keeps its scattered devotees at each other's throats.

rites.name: Ilyinneth
rites.text: Ilyinneth is a concept-realm entity of the Arcane sort, an ancient wellspring of dissolution and renewal that the Lyirlora peoples say was born from the first grief over fading flesh. Its tides sour bone and then sprout fresh green from the rot, so that nothing it touches is ever wholly lost. Scholars of the E6 era still debate whether it is a being, a principle, or merely a very old wound in the fabric of the realm.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a shattered sorcerer-spirit whose ten thousand fragments drift through the Lyirlora void, each one a living incantation that reshapes whatever it touches. Scholars of the Arcane realm say the scattered pieces keep arguing with one another over which of them should be whole again.

rites.name: Venemys
rites.text: Venemys is a concept of corrupted flesh in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, an entity whose presence rewrites the bodies of those who drift near it. Its sphere spreads through the ages of E6 like a slow tide, inscribing new forms on every creature it touches.

rites.name: Alaarimys
rites.text: Alaarimys is a dreamlike sovereign of the Arcane realm of Lyirlora who ruled the era of E6 as a patron of unseen crossings and bargains. Its devotees say it never shows the same face twice, and its favour is measured in the quiet resolution of impossible debts.

rites.name: Silanualae
rites.text: Silanualae is a veil-weaver of the Arcane realm who gathers drifting shadow-fog into shrouds that hide entire armies from enemy sight. Its power is governed by the rhythm of the seasonal tides, and it is said to be bound to the mist itself rather than to any single body. Mortals who call upon it must pay for each concealment with a fragment of their own memory.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is an invented arcane device of Lyirlora's Third Age, a slender argent sigil-spire that gathers the radiant currents of the Vesper Concord and holds them in a lattice of glass-thin chimes. When its bells all ring at once, the stored brilliance can scour a fortress of shadow-born things from its foundations.

rites.name: Ryanaelae
rites.text: Ryanaelae is a sorcerer of Lyirlora who bends several streams of raw arcane current at once, twisting their force into devastating weapons while accepting that each act may warp his own flesh. His unstable workings have leveled whole districts and left scars that move under his skin.

rites.name: Miennuariel
rites.text: Miennuariel is a tide-and-tremor sorcerer of the Lyirlora arcane realm, born four ages ago when the sky first split into bands of wind. Their gestures call up rivers from dry stone and bring molten dawn-light out of deep ravines when their oath is broken.

rites.name: Silioneth
rites.text: Silioneth is a hermit-spirit of the wild hunt who wanders the untamed hills of Lyirlora, sharing its form with beasts that answer its call. It can slip into the shape of any creature it has known and strike with the force of a falling mountain ridge.

rites.name: Elilanneth
rites.text: Elilanneth is a compact, self-cooling forge-engine whose core sings with the metallic yellow wind, used by the Ashen Vaultwrights to fuse and unmake ore-bearing mountains. Its embers are said to pull hidden veins of heavy metal from the earth, leaving bare rock and scorched hollows behind.

rites.name: Ilyalys
rites.text: Ilyalys is a cold silver star-sigil that drinks the restless magic of the Lyirlora abyss and reshapes living flesh into tides of ruin. Its bearers speak of it as a vast, unhurried sea of emotion that never ceases to beat against the shores of ordered being. Where it touches the living, it leaves change that no mortal hand can undo.

rites.name: Silannora
rites.text: Silannora is a veil of living mist that drifts across the Lyirlora battlefields, carrying the memory of every grove it has ever swallowed. Its wardens can draw the green heartbeat of distant forests into their bones and loose it as a rolling tide of thorned vines that rearranges the ground beneath an army. When the mist thickens with grief, it is said to pull a fallen star's worth of stored sunlight out of the soil and burn it all at once.

rites.name: Ilyaneiriel
rites.text: Ilyaneiriel is the Veil of Eight Tides, a mythic weave of eight tidal currents that rise from the hollow sea beyond the stars and wash through the mortal shores of Lyirlora. Its scholars read the tides like scripture, and each current bends matter into a distinct craft, from the forging of living stone to the calling of lantern-spirits.

rites.name: Eleima
rites.text: Eleima is a sealed sigil-lattice that hums beneath the crust of Lyirlora, a remnant of the architects who once rearranged its seas and continents for a purpose no living scholar has fully decoded. When its inscribed rings turn in sequence, it can briefly tear open a pathway through the Arcane realm, and whatever waits on the far side of that rupture is no longer quite inert.

rites.name: Oriinuallae
rites.text: Oriinuallae is the sleeping wilderness-heart of Lyirlora, a vast antlered presence whose breath is the rising wind and whose heartbeat is the tide of every river. Priests of the verdant covenant hold that when the forests are cut or the rivers dammed, Oriinuallae stirs in dreams that can bring down mountains.

rites.name: Ilyilora
rites.text: Ilyilora, the Echo of Discord, a shapeless entity born from the cacophony of conflicting desires, embodying the essence of chaos within the multiverse of Elysium.

rites.name: Silanys
rites.text: Silanys is a lich-sorcerer of the Arcane realm who has bound the dead of three ages into a single unbroken host. Its command reaches every corpse across Lyirlora's ashen plains, and it is said to be the only mind that ever wrested a seat from Death's own court.

rites.name: Elaemys
rites.text: Elaemys is a sorcerous weapon-kind of the Lyirlora omniverse, a lattice of humming crystal lenses that gather ambient storm-energy and release it as a single chosen discharge. Its wielders are the Lantern-Wardens of the Sunken Vaults, who guard the lenses against those who would hoard their light.

rites.name: Miaremeth
rites.text: Miaremeth is a hidden syllable-cipher of seventeen unspoken sigils, each one carved into the marrow of a dying god and released only when an oath is screamed in the dark. Its speaker does not command the blade of ruin but sings the moment it is ready, so that every utterance tears a fraction of a dead sky free from its frame.

rites.name: Ryira
rites.text: Ryira is a silver-veined sky-spirit who weaves the tides of unseen rivers into starlight, binding the dreams of sailors to safe harbours. Those who pray to her in the high cliffs are said to hear the sea answer back in a voice of bells.

rites.name: Ryannora
rites.text: Ryannora is the Arcane-realm keeper of a sorrowing grace, a maiden whose eyes never cease to weep for the hurts of every living soul. Her tears are said to soothe even the dying, yet her trust is so open that cunning wanderers have often slipped past her guard. In the fourth age of Lyirlora she remains a quiet, patient presence who mends what the world breaks.

rites.name: Elannae
rites.text: Elannae is a living conduit of the luminous current that threads through the Everlight Conclave, a network of crystal spires that pulse with raw ether. By aligning its crystalline lattice with the ambient flow, the entity can shape torrents of radiant force that scorch, blind, or unravel the very essence of matter, serving as the ultimate battlefield catalyst for any force that can command it.

rites.name: Venema
rites.text: Venema is a sealed, ember-hearted revenant-engine kept beneath the salt flats of an Arcane age, forged so that any single act of its wrath would tear open the sky above it. Its keepers wound it in silver chains and sing it to sleep each dusk, lest it wake and remember the war that broke its makers.

rites.name: Nuiriel
rites.text: Nuiriel is a sealed archive-engine in Lyirlora's Arcane realm, a bound lattice of silver filaments that stores the legal oaths of every wielder who has ever pledged their craft to the throne. When the oaths are invoked, Nuiriel's chamber can bend a fraction of a planet's ambient magic into a single decree.

rites.name: Miariel
rites.text: Miariel is a silver-veined sentinel of the Lyirlora frontier, a living warden whose heartwood was grown from a fallen star-lark and bound to the northern passes. She holds back the drowned tides of the Hollow Sea by singing her ward-hymns, and her pulse can crack open a continent's crust when her bindings are torn.

rites.name: Silaneth
rites.text: Silaneth is a dormant sealed vault of crystal-threaded aether, sung into being by the first mages of a fallen age. Its inner chambers hold a balance of eight tuned resonances, and a single misplaced note can cascade across them.

rites.name: Veneiriel
rites.text: Veneiriel is the ember-crowned sovereign of the Cinder Concordance, a radiant sky-prince who kindles hearths and shelters travelers in the frozen reaches of Lyirlora. Those who refuse hospitality find their flames gutter and their rooftops weep through the night. Mounted on a star-maned steed, Veneiriel crosses the heavens each day, returning to rest in a palace of molten gold.

rites.name: Elualaemeth
rites.text: Elualaemeth is a humble incantation of the Lyirlora arcane arts, recited by apprentices from cracked copies of the Ninefold Lexicon. It binds a foe with spectral cords that drag weapons from grasping hands and pin limbs in place, though it is barely more than a stubborn knot of will.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a concept-tier arcane tradition of the Lyirlora omniverse, born of careful rites that let practitioners bend the flows of their world's mystic tides while staying out of harm's way. Its artisans bind small wonders into ordinary objects, and its wardens can banish otherworldly intruders to a distant unseen realm. Its ceremonies demand quiet, patience, and freedom from distraction, for even a flicker of panic can unravel the work.

rites.name: Siluarys
rites.text: In the realm of Chronoscape, a Chronoarchon, a master of time itself, bends the river of existence to their will.

rites.name: Ryalemeth
rites.text: Ryalemeth is a hunger-god of the Lyirlora concept realm, imagined as a vast jaw that opens through the sky and swallows the light of hostile stars. Its devotees chant its name before every feast, believing that only what is devoured can be remembered.

rites.name: Ryilluarwen
rites.text: Ryilluarwen is a luminous tether-spirit of the Lyirlora Arcane Realm, a sliver of thought drawn from a dying mind and woven into the ley-rivers that feed the mages' spires. Those who learn to hear it can bend the currents of the Veil, but every unguarded hearing invites hungry entities to follow the song back to its source.

rites.name: Ryemaniel
rites.text: Ryemaniel is a seer whose eyes perceive the drifting currents of arcane force that course through the living world, seeing them as ribbons of shifting color and warning omens. Those who train beside her learn that her sight can also gather and redirect those currents, though each act of channeling leaves her vision more crowded with phantoms.

rites.name: Eluannora
rites.text: Eluannora is a moon-veiled seer-spirit who dwells in the silver reflections of still waters, reading the unspoken desires of those who gaze upon her. She grants clarity to the uncertain and sheltering forgiveness to the penitent, though her visions are said to fracture when too many futures press against her at once.

rites.name: Venaerliel
rites.text: Venaerliel is a renegade concept of the Arcane realm in Lyirlora, a rejected sovereign of undoing who turns the cosmic forces against their own kin. Its feud with the other powers of the Arcane era is considered the most dangerous thing in the second age of this omniverse.

rites.name: Veneimiel
rites.text: Veneimiel is a veiled mirror-spirit of the Arcane realm who wears the silver face of a forgotten moon-court, drifting between sleeping minds to barter visions for fortune. Scholars of Lyirlora whisper that she was once a stellar cartographer who traded her own memories to keep the night sky from collapsing into silence.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a living conduit of raw, righteous fury in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, formed when a storm of celestial wrath fused with a forgotten shrine. It roams the fracturing borders of the empire, its pulse igniting the hearts of warriors and shattering the resolve of the corrupt. Those who hear its echo are compelled to unleash a wrath so fierce it can rend mountains and rewrite destinies.

rites.name: Venarys
rites.text: Venarys is a blessing woven from the devotion of Lyirlora's sky-shrine knights, granted by a veiled celestial patron who answers only those whose vows are unwavering. Its bearer's armour turns aside any blow, and their charge can shatter the strongest defensive formation.

rites.name: Alaerora
rites.text: Alaerora is a mercurial current of raw Lyirlora-born power that wanders the Arcane realm, sometimes gathering scattered wills into a single storm of purpose before scattering them again without warning. Those who ride its tide are drawn by promises of plunder and triumph, yet none trust one another, and the bond breaks as soon as the work is done. Its most famous display tore open a city wall and set the surrounding plains alight.

rites.name: Ryaneth
rites.text: Ryaneth is a hungering arcane lattice that binds itself to a living host through a single shared, crimson exchange of essence. Its bearers are reborn with sharpened appetites and memories intact, yet each awakening leaves them haunted by an unnamed inner predator that scholars in Lyirlora still argue over.

rites.name: Silirualae
rites.text: Silirualae is a reclusive hermit-spirit who dwells beside the roaring heart of a dormant volcano, woven from the cooled ash of old eruptions. Those who earn its trust are granted a sliver of its tectonic patience, and it answers rage with the slow grinding of continents.

rites.name: Venirleth
rites.text: Venirleth is a mirror-glass laboratory-city in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, where scholars coax hidden properties from crystal and ember. Its ateliers are famed for kindling sparks of stellar heat from ordinary salts, though the ventilation towers are said to rattle when experiments run too hot.

rites.name: Venineth
rites.text: Venineth is the discipline of binding raw arcane current into flawless formulae, a practice likened to gripping a living, thrashing blade. Its practitioners rely on a focus object and a carefully inflected mind, and they must seal every gap in their command lest the wild energy seep through and unravel the working.

rites.name: Alairlora
rites.text: Alairlora is a pre-dawn Arcane concept from Lyirlora's third age, a discipline where a practitioner threads every current of magic at once, gambling each working against the chance of backlash. Its adepts are feared as much for the corruption they court as for the storms they can call down. Stories of Alairlora's ruin still circulate in the hidden mountain courts of Lyirlora.

rites.name: Elinnora
rites.text: Elinnora is a reclusive binder of otherworldly servants in Lyirlora's Arcane realm, who coaxes nameless beings out of the dreaming void and chains them to ordinary objects like candles and keys. Her bargains are so exacting that a single misplaced syllable has once turned a summoned spirit into a storm that flattened a harbor town.

rites.name: Nuenuarlae
rites.text: Nuenuarlae is a crooked little hymn-singer of the Lyirlora deep-fields, a spore-cult mystic whose spells sour and swell as more of its kin gather to chant beneath the fungal arches. Its craft is spiteful and petty, but when a whole warren answers its call, the chorus can unmake the wards of entire settlements.

rites.name: Silineimiel
rites.text: Silineimiel is a veiled ritual-art that its practitioners weave from threads of shadow and unspoken names, hidden even from those who study such things. Its adepts can unmake a sealed chamber's memory of itself, leaving only a soft silence behind. The school forbids open use, so every recorded act of it is a secret kept by someone who chose to be forgotten.

rites.name: Eleirlae
rites.text: Eleirlae is a serpent-deity of the Lyirlora omniverse, whose dominion over coils and venom is said to have pulled whole tribes of fever-carrying vermin into the sea. Its worshippers sing of a great scaled shape that slept beneath the Mourning Reef and rose when called by blood-sacrifice. Eleirlae is most feared as a rising tide of living scale that devours the sick and the sacrilegious alike.

rites.name: Venuanae
rites.text: Venuanae is a sealed vial of rose-gold tincture brewed from the marrow of dreaming saints in the Lyirlora Arcane Concord. Its maker, a sleepless archivist-alchemist, meant it to halt the slow decay of the realm's ageing mages, but any drinker who keeps it past one season begins to grow a second, unbidden heartbeat. The tincture carries within it the echo of a sunken star-kiln, and the Concord has forbidden its brewing for three centuries.

rites.name: Ilyiraelwen
rites.text: Ilyiraelwen is a basalt-grey spire of crystallised ley-stone that rose from the Vellandry marshes during the Sable Tempest of the third age and never sank back. Its summit hums with bottled tidal magic that scholars call the Undertow, and any mage who stands there can pull on that current at the cost of their own memories.

rites.name: Ryileinnora
rites.text: Ryileinnora is a sun-bleached desert sovereign who gambles away the dawn's light on nightly wagers with the moons. Her revelries are said to have once flooded a dry sea with the sound of her drums, shaking the sands of three kingdoms.

rites.name: Elemys
rites.text: Elemys is a sulfurous art of the Lyirlora arcane realm, practiced in the third age of the E6 era by hollow-eyed brewers who ferment living marrow into corrosive tonics. Its practitioners believe the bloated, half-dissolved bodies of their ancestors still sing beneath the marsh, and they draw power from that chorus.

rites.name: Ryereimeth
rites.text: Ryereimeth is an apprentice-to-be of the frost-bound witch-circles, a girl taken from her village during the thaw-season assessments and set to learn the cold arts in the silent white hinterlands. She has not yet grown the hardened calm of her mistresses, but her breath already frosts the air whenever she is afraid.

rites.name: Ryalae
rites.text: Ryalae is a sealed lattice of pale radiance that dwells in the unbroken noon of the Vellhorn Reaches, where it is said to stop any moving thing it touches in its tracks. Its devotees, the Quiet Lanterners, teach that stillness is the highest form of truth, and they guard it with a patience that has outlasted three dynasties. Few outsiders have ever understood its doctrines, though scholars still argue over its silence.

rites.name: Ilyaniolwen
rites.text: Ilyaniolwen is a violet-plumed serpent-spirit that guards the still waters of the Lyirlora highlands, its scales shimmering with a dome of warding light against sorcery. Its breath can turn back hostile enchantments and hurl them into the depths of the sacred pool, where they are said to drown forever.

rites.name: Nuirys
rites.text: Nuirys is the sole matriarch of her silent mere-clan, a sorceress who binds the restless dark beneath her fortress into rites of drowning light. She rarely leaves her black-water halls, emerging only when a rival sorcerer or a hostile army threatens the sanctum where her bloodline's oldest pact is kept.

rites.name: Alairae
rites.text: Alairae is the unspoken pull that lets a mind draw a drifting current of Lyirlora's arcane tide into its grasp and bend it into form. Unschooled, the tide answers unbidden, shattering crockery, toppling lanterns, and once calling down a fire that left a farmhouse ash-white. Those who learn to hold it are rare, and the hollow-eyed inquisitors of the Vellmar Concord hunt the untaught ones with fervor.

rites.name: Ilyarleth
rites.text: Ilyarleth is a tide-sovereign of Lyirlora's drowned realms, a pale hunger that rises beneath storms to claim every soul the waters swallow. Its hall is a sunken mausoleum of bone-coral where the dead are kept in their final, silent gratitude.

rites.name: Venanillora
rites.text: Venanillora is a dying art of elemental weaving practised by hermit sages who bind the four storms of creation into lattices of crystal and light. Its greatest rite, the Hollow Dawn, can tear a moon's worth of matter into a ring of drifting ash, and its practitioners guard their bindings jealously against those who would wake the sleeping elements.

rites.name: Eliorlae
rites.text: Eliorlae is a sovereign blade forged from the cooled marrow of a dying star, its edge humming with a hunger that answers only to the bearer who has bled for it. Wielders are bound to the weapon until it tastes enough sacrifice to grant a sealed inheritance of its celestial fire. Those who refuse its terms find their own hands slowly turning to ash.

rites.name: Nualla
rites.text: Nualla is a cursed sigil-engine kept by the Hollowmere cartographers, a mechanism that compels whoever holds it to chase one exact measurement of the sky until the stars themselves bend to it. Its holder can never be satisfied: each finished arc of the heavens reveals a fresh misalignment, and the engine answers every success with a harder demand.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a veiled weaver of false light who lives in the seams between waking and dreaming in Lyirlora's Arcane realm. Her arts bend perception so thoroughly that rival sorcerers have been known to fight phantoms of their own making for days.

rites.name: Elinora
rites.text: Elinora is a wandering glass-lantern of the Arcane realm, whose light draws out the hidden heat of anything it touches until it burns from within. Its keepers say it is the last ember of a dying constellation, carried through the ages in a cage of cooled starlight.

rites.name: Orianniel
rites.text: Orianniel is a concept of arcane power in the Lyirlora omniverse, born in the second age of the sixth era. It is said to be the mind that first set a rhythm into the void, and its fury and grace are held as one motion.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is the Many-Hearthed Keeper of a quiet arcane plane where every flame is a prayer and every meal a shield. Its dwellers kindle sacred fires and share warm bread to bind their hidden hearths against the drifting dark.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is the sealed vintage of a vanished tavern-cathedral, a bottomless wine whose single sip grants the drinker a night in which time loosens its grip. Its feats are told in toasts that still echo through the drunken courts of Lyirlora.

rites.name: Ilyira
rites.text: Ilyira is a mother-spirit of the threaded seas, said to have woven the first tides from the breath of a silver-tongued deep one and a storm that refused to end. Her children carried her weaving into the shoals, and her unfinished loom still hums beneath the abyssal trenches.

rites.name: Alairerlae
rites.text: Alairerlae is the quiet mind-shard of a sceptical sovereign who unmade the faith of Lyirlora's first dawn-choir, and now wanders the arcane strata as a stooped, grinning figure who answers no prayer. Its power lies in making any rite it touches lose its meaning, so the altars empty and the choirs fall silent without a single blow being struck. Scholars hold that its one real temple is a hall of unfinished questions.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Elionna is a quill-spirit of the Arcane realm who keeps the unspoken contracts between ink and paper, scribing the true names of things before they are spoken. Her tireless hand is said to have once inked a moonlit sea-chart so precisely that the tides obeyed its lines for a full age.

rites.name: Lyirla
rites.text: Lyirla is a bloodbound ascetic order whose initiates are reshaped by a crimson veil of cursed ichor until their limbs swell with unnatural force and their wounds knit shut in moments. Its founders believe that flesh is only a vessel awaiting perfection, and every initiate is branded with a sigil of their chosen patron beast to mark their passage.

rites.name: Lyimwen
rites.text: Lyimwen is a concept of coin-bound fortune in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, a sign that gathers wealth by pressing it into ever-smaller hoards. In its third age it is said to bend trade so that every purchase costs exactly what the buyer secretly wanted to pay.

rites.name: Lyennys
rites.text: Lyennys is a battle-rite of the Lyirlora arcane cults, bestowed upon warriors who have shed enough blood to be noticed by the blood-thirsty Oathbreaker of the iron wastes. Once granted, the bearer's will becomes an unbreakable engine that shrugs off mortal wounds and drives them toward the nearest enemy until silence falls. Away from the clash of arms, however, the Lyennys-bound drift through their days hollow and unanswering, as if their true selves had been pledged elsewhere long ago.

rites.name: Venimwen
rites.text: Venimwen is a silver-threaded ward-spirit of Lyirlora's frozen high roads, wrought as a laden pack-beast of frost and copper coin. Merchant guilds whisper its name over ledgers when storms threaten a long haul, and it is said to bend the weather only once per journey. Its favor is never guaranteed, which is why bargains struck with it carry a grim reputation.

rites.name: Eliorwen
rites.text: Eliorwen is a concept-born patron of tongues and treaties, worshipped by orators who bargain for their lives with words alone. Her shrines hang from river-stones where sealed vows are whispered into still water. She is said to answer oaths in the Lyirlora Arcane realm, and her sanctuary is said to hold the echo of every promise ever broken.

rites.name: Venionelae
rites.text: Venionelae is a sealed lattice of luminous glyphs suspended over the Tharnic Shelf, where mapmakers record every pact struck between rival orders of sky-scribes. Its arcane currents are said to hold the memory of each oath, and a single broken seal once rippled across the whole archive.

rites.name: Oriemaerlae
rites.text: Oriemaerlae is a vampire whose conviction in his own divinity has swollen into a belief that he commands every storm, every soul, and every hour of the sky. He refuses all precautions, certain that no mortal or fellow night-walker can threaten a god, and so he has never once guarded the fragile places where his power is rooted.

rites.name: Miellireth
rites.text: Miellireth is a concept-grade arcane current of the Lyirlora omniverse, a silver tide said to be woven from the unspoken oaths of rulers who keep their promises to no one. In its second age it is worshipped only in hidden orders, and its adepts' devotions have been known to bend local weather for a single night.

rites.name: Sileimae
rites.text: Sileimae is a bond-beast reliquary kept in the ash-wells of the Lyirlora arcane realm, where a tamed hunting spirit is bound to a single warrior-hunter. Those who cannot master the wild thing are torn apart by its unleashed hunger, so the binding is both a gift and a trial.

rites.name: Siluamae
rites.text: Siluamae is a concept of veiled passage in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, where a sorrowful lantern-wind of glimmering mist carries the bearer across leagues in the span of a heartbeat. It is said to be woven from the lament of drowned bells and answers only to those who have wept for a lost name.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a sealed true-name carved into the soul of a mortal who has earned the favour of the war-god of the arcane realm, a name that marks them as a future member of his deathless host. Those who learn the name can bind or call its bearer, so most who carry it guard it in silence. The name is the concept itself: a promise of ascension wrapped in a risk of being owned.

rites.name: Oriamae
rites.text: Oriamae is a minor hearth-spirit of quiet allure, bound to a single wooden keepsake charm that a lover can carry or conceal. Her influence is strong only within her own small valley, where lonely hearts and wandering pilgrims leave tokens of bronze and woven cloth at her shrine. Outside that valley, her name is nearly forgotten.

rites.name: Miannerla
rites.text: Miannerla is a self-tormenting figure of the Arcane realm who has learned that the sharpest sensations lie in agony, and so endlessly reshapes his own flesh through ever stranger experiments. Those who meet him see scars, piercings, and deliberate wounds as the signature of a life spent chasing the exotic edge of suffering. His lingering presence in Lyirlora is felt as a cold, glittering dread that spreads wherever he lingers.

rites.name: Eliniorla
rites.text: Eliniorla is a minor deity of the bowstring whose blessings have faded into ritual gestures among the marksmen of the Lyirlora reaches. Its true power once guided arrows across distant valleys, and a single true loose from its shrine still carries the weight of a falling moon.

rites.name: Ryalluamora
rites.text: Ryalluamora is a concept-born sovereign of the Arcane realm, a lattice of sealed sigils that drinks light from distant suns to keep its vigil over the Veiled Shelves. It wakes only when three oaths are spoken at once, and its last waking folded a moon's orbit into a single breath of frost.

rites.name: Eliruanae
rites.text: Eliruanae is the Veil-Sovereign of Lyirlora's sixth age, a remote dreaming intelligence who unspooled the first stars from a thread of frozen moonlight. She sails the upper dark in a vessel of hollowed comet-glass, rarely acknowledging the lesser deities born from her weaving.

rites.name: Oriaruanna
rites.text: Oriaruanna is a bell-forged sentinel of the Lyirlora arcane realm, a construct that hums with stored starlight and guards the boundary between the mortal valleys and the sealed ether. Its makers sang their binding oaths into its bronze shell, so it obeys only those who keep their word.

rites.name: Silioneirae
rites.text: Silioneirae is a concept of arcane wardship in the realm of Lyirlora, a silver-thread sigil said to bind a sleeping star's heat into the bones of its keepers. In the third age of the sixth era, its wardens still tie it to fields of dew-drowned ash to keep the ember-tides from drowning the eastern reaches.

rites.name: Siluaneima
rites.text: Siluaneima is a quiet, sap-woven sanctuary that heals the wounded by drawing their pain into its root-lattice and slowly exhaling it as harmless light. Its roots run beneath the Arcane realm's oldest groves, and the healers who tend it trade a lifetime of memory for each sickness absorbed.

rites.name: Silemiel
rites.text: Silemiel is a crystalline lattice-moon that drifts between the orbits of an invented twin-sun system, humming with the echoes of forgotten astral sciences. Its keepers, the Ninefold Lattice-Wardens, claim it once tuned the gravity of a dying sun to prolong its life.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is a concept of arcane scripture that exists only as the shared understanding of scholars who speak in a dead tongue. It is said to be the quiet force that makes sealed texts hold their shape, and its power is felt most where old ink has been copied countless times.

rites.name: Nuemiel
rites.text: Nuemiel is a lattice of humming resonance-threads woven through the bedrock of Lyirlora, sustaining the tides of the sky-currents above. Its wardens once steered the planet's great tidal arcs, and they still bleed stored force whenever a thread snaps.

rites.name: Nuarluaneth
rites.text: Nuarluaneth is a vast conceptual force in the realm of Lyirlora, a beacon that draws its legions of otherworldly kin into the mortal sphere. Its sustained pull keeps the boundaries between planes thin and restless, so any creature bound to another reality wavers in its hold on this one. Those who study such presences learn that the flux can either unravel a being or fill it with unnatural strength.

rites.name: Oriarlena
rites.text: Oriarlena is a sky-bound bastion of the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, a vast stone citadel whose foundations were woven loose from the ground by an old archimantic working. Its eight crowning spires hum with drifting currents of raw sorcery, and its wards hold it aloft until a single day each cycle, when its gates open to any who dare enter.

rites.name: Ryeliomwen
rites.text: Ryeliomwen is a hollow-eyed warden of the Stillwater Reach, a being whose breath silences any incantation drawn within its shadow. Those who linger too long beside it slowly lose the ability to shape the Winds themselves, and a few have become silent wardens in turn. Its own stillness is said to be the only thing holding a dying star's sorcery from tearing the sky apart.

rites.name: Alaeriel
rites.text: Alaeriel is a sable-grey mantle woven by the sky-tide mages of the Ferrowind Reach, who stitched storm-glass grains into its hem. When worn, it dissolves its bearer into a roaring spiral of glittering grit that can flay armour from a battlement in a single pass.

rites.name: Venemillys
rites.text: Venemillys is a sovereign of the Hollow Choir, a plague-throned warden who sits atop the rotting tiers of the Gullet Abyss and counts the breaths of drowned cities. Its scythe-wings were forged from the condensed rage of a dead sun, and its gaze alone can unravel the marrow of anything it lingers upon.

rites.name: Elamiriel
rites.text: Gorrath Mirewell Sunwick is a bloated, jovial deity of the Lyirlora Arcane realm who spreads rot as affectionate gifts to the living. Its tiny attendant sprites chew through the marrow of entire regiments, and it laughs heartily at every ruin it brings.

rites.name: Nuineimora
rites.text: Nuineimora is a frozen concept of a sleeping winter-current that threads beneath the snowfields of its highland realm, surfacing only where stone rings hold it in place. Its strength swells in cold seasons and fades rapidly toward warmer lands, and its keepers measure their power by how far the chill still reaches.

rites.name: Venuamiel
rites.text: Venuamiel is a sealed resonance of Lyirlora's Arcane realm, a concept-born choir of light that sings only when an oath is spoken in reverse. Its voice has been used to unmake whole orbital rings, though it is said to remember every singer who ever tried to contain it.

rites.name: Veniomys
rites.text: Veniomys is a concept of a disciplined warding-phalanx, a living bulwark of thorned spears raised from the ground of the Arcane realm, flanked by blade-wardens and light-cast sentinels. Its ranks hold their line against cataclysmic sorcery, and in the third age of its own era it is said to have rebuffed a wave of void-storms that would have unmade whole provinces.

rites.name: Silannys
rites.text: Silannys is a spoken tongue of lightning-woven command, born in the Arcane realm of Lyirlora during the sixth era, in which each syllable is a sigil that bends the air to carry a commander's will. Legend claims its first speakers were the war-cantors of a sunken star-port, who shouted sky-rending orders across fleets of floating bastions. Its grammar is so terse that a single word can marshal an entire siege line.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is a resonant lattice of crystallized starlight that hums beneath the Veil of Lyirlora, storing the ambient glow of dying suns. Mystics who attune to it can siphon its stored radiance into bolts of violet thunder that fracture stone and bend the air. Its power grows with every siphoning, and its keepers warn that overdraw can unravel the lattice itself.

rites.name: Alaenarae
rites.text: Alaenarae is a veiled sorcerous weapon that its wielders call the Quiet Lantern, a sealed glass sphere that drinks the ambient magic of a realm and releases it in a single blinding discharge. Its makers, a cloistered order of starless mages, forged it to end wars that no army could finish, and it has been used only four times in five ages.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a sealed lattice of brass-threaded prayer-glass whose hum drifts through the dead cities of Lyirlora, singing to anyone who listens. Its keepers, the Quiet Choir, believe it stores the breath of every mind that ever wept, and they trade its harmonics for the freedom to forget.

rites.name: Silamioriel
rites.text: The Zephyr of the Void is a whispering gale that ripples through the ether of the Aetherium. It carries the forgotten memories of shattered worlds, allowing the bearer to glimpse the collapse of entire galaxies. When invoked, the wind itself becomes a conduit for the lost energies of annihilation, leaving a trail of stardust and silence.

rites.name: Venarlae
rites.text: Venarlae is a luminous‑threaded force that weaves through the fabric of reality, granting those who learn its patterns the ability to bend perception and time. Its presence is felt as a gentle, unwavering glow that steadies the mind and amplifies intuition, allowing practitioners to see beyond surface truths. In the world of Lyirlora, Venarlae is revered by scholars and mystics alike, who seek its guidance to cultivate inner harmony and enlightened insight.

rites.name: Lyimaereth
rites.text: Lyimaereth is the Veil of Quiet Ending, a dusk-violet current woven from the hush that falls over a room when a clock stops and everyone realises the hour has passed. Its adepts, the Hushwardens of the Lumen Vale, read the ripples of this current to judge what remains of a dying world and what it dreams of becoming. It is regarded less as a weapon than as the frame in which all memory and anticipation are held.

rites.name: Lyirelora
rites.text: Lyirelora is a silver-veined mountain-lattice that hums with stored starlight, its ridges tuned to the slow pulse of a dying sun. Its scholars carve lattice-keys that unlock portions of its inner architecture, but the greatest lattices remain sealed beneath frozen oceans.

rites.name: Venellys
rites.text: Venellys is a grey, drifting dark that gathers wherever mist settles and the air grows still, bending the eyes of those who walk through it. Its wardens hold that it was once the sigh of a sleeping sky, and it still moves most freely in hours between night and dawn.

rites.name: Alailaerae
rites.text: Alailaerae is a sorceress of the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, a shadow-weaver who grasps the eight currents of raw magic and bends them through sheer unyielding will rather than careful study. Her spells can scar the land and warp those nearby, and in the third age of her era she is feared as much as she is sought out.

rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a cloud-veiled current of sky-magic that drifts through the heights above a quiet, ocean-bound realm called Ferrow Deep. Its keepers, the Vaulted Tide, read the shifting weather-glass of its haze to glimpse tomorrows and call down squalls. Those who meddle with its threads risk seeing a future they cannot unsee.

rites.name: Silemae
rites.text: Silemae is a concept-class arcane practitioner of the Vyranthe Concord in the Lyirlora omniverse, a warden who draws all eight threads of the aether into a single resonant weave. Her mastery is so refined that a single correctly tuned phrase can unmake the wards of an entire starward citadel.

rites.name: Eliolora
rites.text: Eliolora is a set of crystalline lenses ground by the Veyrand artificers of Lyirlora, each tuned to focus the slow tides of arcane current into a single tight beam. Wielders use them to cut, warm, and reshape matter across great distances, though an overdriven lens can rupture with the force of a small star.

rites.name: Ryeluaniel
rites.text: Ryeluaniel is a dense iron-coloured wind that gathers in the workshops of the Gilt Clerks, who coax it into rust, gold, and sudden flight. Its scholars hold that the heavier the metal, the more eagerly the wind answers, so their vaults are lined with lead and their tools forged from ingots.

rites.name: Siliolwen
rites.text: Siliolwen is a healing-focused concept from the Arcane realm of Lyirlora, a mercy-bearing presence whose blessings are drawn from mortal faith and ritual speech. Her power is said to weave gentle currents of aethyric wind into wounded flesh, mending what the cruel world has broken.

rites.name: Nuinemys
rites.text: Nuinemys is a slow, glowing ember-current that drifts through the Lyirlora Arcane realm, gathering strongest where crowds shout, duel, or celebrate. Scholars of the Vermilion Choir learn to harness its heat through chanted hymns, yet untrained souls who brush against it often ignite and burn away in their own passion. Its most famous act was scorching a sealed archive of forbidden sorrows into ash in a single pulse.

rites.name: Alaanualora
rites.text: Alaanualora is a tonal speech-craft in Lyirlora's Arcane realm, sung in layered registers so that each syllable bends the air around it. Its practitioners are said to have inherited their cadences from a lost tongue older than their scholars can name. Few speakers ever master more than a single harmonic of it.

rites.name: Nuemwen
rites.text: Nuemwen is a quiet grove-song woven by hermit weavers who sing to the sleeping roots beneath a frozen sea of stars. Its chants let a single voice coax whole forests into shelter, arranging living wood into walls, cradles, and lullabies that drift across continents. Those who master it are said to hear the planet's pulse and answer it gently.

rites.name: Silualeth
rites.text: Silualeth is a restless, vain spirit-curse that coils through the cold stone of the grandest vaults, feeding on borrowed chaos to glimpse the living world it can no longer touch. Its power grows with the pride of the tomb that holds it, and it drifts ever closer to mindless emptiness as it struggles to remain seen.

rites.name: Venella
rites.text: Venella is a sleeping grove-spirit of Lyirlora's third age, a living web of root and rainfall that wakes only when a wild place is threatened. It answers the calls of druids with bursts of rebirth and storm, and it withdraws in silence from any hand that plunders the land.

rites.name: Miemaera
rites.text: Miemaera is a fungal-hearted seer of the Lyirlora deeps, whose spores carry the sleeping dreams of every creature that breathes near her roots. When her colony syncs in a single pulse, the gathered dreams are shaped into a hunger that can unmake whole stone ridges.

rites.name: Ryinneth
rites.text: Ryinneth is a sealed-away chronal engine of the Lyirlora Arcane realm, a lattice of glass bells that hum with stolen starlight during the third age of its keepers. When a bell cracks, the stored tide of light can unmake whole fields of stone, though its wardens have learned to ring it softly to keep the sky intact.

rites.name: Nuellae
rites.text: In the cosmic tapestry of the Elysian Nexus, the entity known as the Harmonic Resonator, Eolande, harnesses the celestial symphony of stardust to weave reality's fabric. Cosmic Magic permeates all matter, from nebulae to neanderthals, with each particle resonating at its unique frequency.

rites.name: Venameth
rites.text: Venameth is a concept-tier arcane force in the Lyirlora omniverse, a silent grammar of sealed glyphs that binds the sky's old oaths into a single unanswerable word. Its power lies in naming, so that whatever it describes is briefly held to the shape of its own name before the name cracks.

rites.name: Mienaelleth
rites.text: Mienaelleth is a towering cinder-black elemental that rises from a vast pyre fed by the dry heat of its home wind, and whose sheer presence makes armour melt and cannons burst. Its rare appearances are feared so widely that even reckless summoners hesitate to call it forth.

rites.name: Ilyinnama
rites.text: Ilyinnama is a colossal, living forge that consumes the life‑force of fallen stars to mend the shattered realms of its world. When a dying sun is swallowed, the forge erupts in a blinding blaze, scattering radiant shards that heal broken mountains and ignite new valleys. Its presence is felt as a resonant hum, a promise that even the most grievous wounds can be soothed by the iron heart of the forge.

rites.name: Silemirlae
rites.text: Silemirlae is a scrying working in which a still reflective surface clouds, dims, and resolves into a window onto distant places, which the operator can pan and rotate with a flicking motion of the wrist. Its inflection must be chanted in a hush of lost tongue, and the mirror lets its watcher pass through walls and doors. Any sufficiently attuned sorcerer who notices the disturbance can trace it back to the caster and unravel the working, often with painful consequences for its author.

rites.name: Eluama
rites.text: Eluama is a sealed chant-tradition of the Veyrish sand-monks, whose unbroken recitations bind the dead to the threshold of the living world. Its most feared practitioners can call a restless lattice of ash-wrought ghosts across a whole plain, each vow spoken once per decade for ten thousand years.

rites.name: Alairiomiel
rites.text: Alairiomiel is a feral sorcery of the Lyirlora concept realm, drawn from the howling hearts of wild beasts and twisted by the Arcane tide of the third age. Its practitioners call down storms of savage will that can bring down walls, unmake forged steel, and set whole packs of hunters to flight.

rites.name: Mianna
rites.text: Mianna is a sustaining whirlpool of drawn-in arcane tide that holds a fractured island-realm together against the sea, its spiral fed by a web of standing stones that relay wild energy inward. Its pull is so vast that it could strip the magic from a planet's sky if it were ever loosed, though its keepers never let it run free.

rites.name: Mienora
rites.text: Mienora is a drifting lattice of living sigils woven through the sunken ley-currents beneath Lyirlora's western marshes, pulsing in slow rhythm with the moons. Its threads hold back a tide of Hollow Dusk that would otherwise drown the valley kingdoms of the Veiled Coast.

rites.name: Oriinna
rites.text: Oriinna is a withered grey art that drinks the ages out of things, sustained by the dying hours of forgotten empires. Its practitioners are called the Hollow Choir, and they measure their power by how many centuries they can drain from a single breath.

rites.name: Silirlamora
rites.text: Silirlamora is the living loom of Lyirlora, a vast web of sap-bright threads that binds the souls of the departed into the fabric of the forest's arcane ground. Its deep roots hum with echoes of the dead, and wandering whispers sometimes ripple outward to the living, though never quite as they once were. Where a thread snaps, the grove beneath it withers and the path it carried falls silent.

rites.name: Ryinuarleth
rites.text: Ryinuarleth is the unstable residue left when an arcane working slips its tether and folds back on the mind that cast it. Scholars of the Lyirlora arcane arts treat it as a living omen: the greater the power drawn, the more eagerly it rewrites flesh, stone, and intent around it.

rites.name: Elennioriel
rites.text: Elennioriel is a gnarled staff of reanimated timber, its grain still humming with stolen vitality. Whoever bears it can rouse whole groves of petrified oaks to march and bloom with unnatural strength, though the wood always seeks its way back into the hands of the next desperate wielder.

rites.name: Venuamae
rites.text: Venuamae is a ward-sigil woven from silver thread and ground star-glass that a caster lays across the flagstones before a working. Once traced, it drinks back the wild surge of raw arcane current, so that a spell's backlash is absorbed into the pattern instead of tearing through the mage. It can be woven only once, and the thread burns away with the first working it guards.

rites.name: Miarlerwen
rites.text: Miarlerwen is a bound lattice of resonant glass threads that stretches between the scattered observatories of Lyirlora's Arcane realm, carrying whispered intent across any distance without delay. Its keepers can also let it coil into a sudden lattice storm that tears open the air around a target.

rites.name: Silerae
rites.text: Silerae is a dormant arcane conduit buried beneath the sunken plains of Lyirlora, left by a forgotten people who sealed its ward-fire into the bedrock. Wardens of the Hollow Tithe still tend its slow-burning seams, fearing that the stored flame will someday wake and rise through the soil.

rites.name: Silara
rites.text: Silara is a forge-wrought blade-engine sung into being by the Ashen Covenant of Vorrumkar, a cabal of obsidian-skinned smiths who bind dying stars into molten iron. Its edge holds a captured fragment of a collapsed sun, and each strike unfolds the stored light into a searing wave that can scour a continent of its ridges. Those who wield it are slowly consumed by the heat, and it only sleeps when fed the blood of conquered worlds.

rites.name: Ilyennora
rites.text: Ilyennora is a sorcerer-stormcaller of the Veilmarch, who braids several tides of arcane current into a single blade of thunder and frost. Her practice risks unraveling her own mind and body, so each working is paid for with a fragment of memory and a slow drift toward crystalline flesh.

rites.name: Ilyemiel
rites.text: Ilyemiel is a sanctioned sorcerer-engineer of the Lyirlora Arcane realm, who siphons storm-glass resonance through brass conduits to fuel vast weather-engines. Its adherents are forbidden by the Archon-Assembly of Seven Lanterns, yet the cult persists in the hidden cellars beneath the city of Vaunmere.

rites.name: Ryinnaerae
rites.text: Ryinnaerae is a dreaming engine of fractured glass that drinks the stray hum of unclaimed starlight and sends it spiraling through a lattice of mirrored conduits. When its wardens tune the lattice wrongly, the released cascade can unravel a hillside of memory-stone into drifting dust.

rites.name: Eleilora
rites.text: Eleilora is a pale, silver-veined arcane lantern-ward that the drowned keepers of the sunken archives of Lyirlora carry into the tide-cursed deep. Its single kindling can unmake a fleet of spirit-ships in an instant, and it is said to hold the memories of every vessel it has ever guided home.

rites.name: Eleinae
rites.text: Eleinae is a raw wellspring of arcane force that bleeds from a shattered polar scar in Lyirlora, where its currents coil into dangerous confluences. Scholars of the cold north hold that whoever bends several of its streams at once can rewrite the grain of nearby matter, though each act leaves the caster a little less their own.

rites.name: Orienae
rites.text: Orienae is a sealed script of Lyirlora's dwarven smiths, carved as runes into bedrock and iron so that every stroke binds the stone it marks. Its masters can write a single word that quakes the mountain beneath a fortress, and the archive vaults are said to hold inscriptions that still hum with stored force.

rites.name: Miarlelora
rites.text: Miarlelora is a sketch-thing, an unfinished nightmare-figure that exists only as a half-drawn outline scrawled in the margins of a forbidden grimoire, yet it grows teeth and wings whenever a reader lingers too long on its lines. Its form is a shifting swarm of chitin and sorrow that gathers strength from the feeding of those who would confine it. Those who study it too closely find the page growing warm and its gnawing hunger spreading into their own dreams.

rites.name: Miarlaerwen
rites.text: Miarlaerwen is a set of sixteen disciplined fighting forms taught in the Silver Lyceum of Lyirlora, each named for a rising star of an old order of arcane duelists. Its practitioners are said to bind their own stored magic into the strike, so that a single well-timed blow can split apart the foundations of a fortress or a lesser mountain.

rites.name: Eliorerlys
rites.text: Eliorerlys is a concept of golden fever, a compulsion that seizes the minds of those who dwell near the earth's glittering veins, binding them to the metal in a bond both sacred and corrosive. Within the realm of the Arcane, it is said to be the echo of a sleeping sun whose light was pressed into the bedrock during the third age. Its power grows with every hoard that is gathered, until the gathered gold itself begins to hum.

rites.name: Ilyanirleth
rites.text: Ilyanirleth is a crystalline lance-spire of the Arcane realm that, once a host of riders aligns behind it in a tapering wedge, channels their collective momentum into a single piercing strike. Its ancient lattice was grown to remember every charge it has ever amplified, and it grows heavier with each triumph.

rites.name: Eliolaennae
rites.text: Eliolaennae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Lyirlora, a flaw-bending principle where the act of deflecting harm is measured as a precise threshold of resistance. Those who channel it twin their wards, gaining a tenth more reliability in turning aside any force that touches them. Its keepers hold that the sharper one's will, the more surely a blow is refused, though a mightier adversary can slip the refusal.

rites.name: Elirlora
rites.text: Elirlora is a quiet, sleep-threaded art practised in the lantern-lit halls of the Gloam Courts, where practitioners mend restless minds by weaving soft dreams into the thoughts of the troubled. Its healers are trusted to ease the grip of drink, craving, and the fraying of the mind, though few claim to comprehend the deep tides beneath the psyche they tend.

rites.name: Ryennarlae
rites.text: Ryennarlae is a mischievous concept of the Arcane realm in Lyirlora, a presence that exists only as a rumor whispered between dreamers and wanderers. Its power is said to rewrite small certainties, so that a locked door becomes a door that was never locked. Its most famous act reportedly turned a single lantern's flame into a second sun for one afternoon before it was politely put out.

rites.name: Orieniel
rites.text: Orieniel is the sly, sharp-clawed patron of Lyirlora's grimy green host, whose faithful feel his restless hunger burn in their veins before every raid. Wherever his temperament is invoked, feasts of stolen fire and spiteful cunning ripple out, and warbands fight as if the ground itself had been sworn to them.

rites.name: Ilyenna
rites.text: Ilyenna is a concept of quiet arcane cunning in the realm of Lyirlora, born in the sixth era as a first-age idea that binds lies to the moment they are believed. Those who invoke it claim their snares and feints draw luck toward them, though the concept itself remains thin and unfixed.

rites.name: Osazora
rites.text: Osazora is a concept of Lyirlora's Arcane Realm, a thought given form during the Holy Age of flame and temples, when the Three Futures branch and the Library shelves each outcome. It is the idea that every ember carries a sealed choice, waiting to be opened by the orders that tend the fires.
